from django.db import models


class AcmeRequest(models.Model):
    """One table of the module. Every company has its own copy (django-tenants TENANT_APPS)."""
    number = models.CharField(max_length=30, blank=True, db_index=True)
    employee = models.ForeignKey('EmpManagement.emp_master', on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name='+')   # link to ZEO, never change ZEO's tables
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    status = models.CharField(max_length=12, default='draft', choices=(('draft', 'Draft'), ('submitted', 'Submitted'), ('approved', 'Approved')))
    created_by = models.ForeignKey('UserManagement.CustomUser', null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, related_name='+')
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        ordering = ['-id']
        permissions = [('approve_acmerequest', 'Can approve Acme requests')]
backend/ZeoAcme/views.py:
from rest_framework import viewsets

from .models import AcmeRequest
from .serializers import AcmeRequestSerializer


class AcmeRequestViewSet(viewsets.ModelViewSet):
    """AccessControl (installed for every DRF view) checks the company, the rights add_/change_/delete_/view_acmerequest and
    the user's branches – nothing to add here for the usual rules."""
    queryset = AcmeRequest.objects.select_related('employee')
    serializer_class = AcmeRequestSerializer

    def perform_create(self, serializer):
        obj = serializer.save(created_by=self.request.user)
        obj.number = f'ACM-{obj.pk:05d}'
        obj.save(update_fields=['number'])

from django_tenants.test.cases import TenantTestCase


class AcmeTests(TenantTestCase):
    def test_negative_amount_refused(self):
        from ZeoAcme.serializers import AcmeRequestSerializer
        s = AcmeRequestSerializer(data={'employee': 1, 'title': 'x', 'amount': '-1'})
        self.assertFalse(s.is_valid())
